newsitem.title: USA: Innovex Q1 boosted by strong demand.
newsitem.headline: Innovex Q1 boosted by strong demand.

text.p: Innovex Inc on Tuesday attributed its record December 31 first-quarter results to stronger-than-expected demand for lead wires.
Chairman Thomas Haley also noted in a statement, "Revenues from our newly acquired Litchfield Precision Components Division were greater than originally anticipated."
The company reported earnings per share of $0.42, up from $0.19 a share a year earlier. Revenues advanced to $29.3 million from $13.1 million.
Innovex, which makes electrical components for the computer electronics and medical instruments markets, said its first quarter historically is its weakest.
